player_prompt.intro:
Mukutembenuza Tower of Hanoi ndi {num_disks} ma-disiki.
Mukufunika kusunthira ma-disiki kuchoka kwa tower A kupita kwa tower C.
Ili musunthire disiki, lembani tower imene mukuchokera nayo ndi tower imene mukupita nayo (e.g., '[A C]').
Onani kuti mungathe kusunthira disiki ya juu ya tower pekee, ndi kuti disiki iliyoikulu isingatheke kusangidwa pa disiki iliyo ndogo.
Pa kila mpini, perekani mpini mmoja.

invalid_move.invalid_tower: Mwasankha gwero kapena nsanja yosagwira ntchito.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Munayesa kusuntha chimbale kuchokera ku nsanja yopanda kanthu.
invalid_move.same_tower: Munayesa kusamutsa chimbale kupita ku nsanja imodzimodziyo.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Munayesa kuika chimbale chachikulu pa chaching'ono.

game_action.moved: Inu anasamukira chimbale {disk} kuchokera ku {source} kuti {target}.

outcome.win: Tikukuyamikirani chifukwa chothetsa vuto la Tower of Hanoi.
outcome.turn_limit: M'mphepete mwa malire a kutembenuka kwafika. Mwaika molondola {pct}% ya ma disks pa Tower C.
